name: 2023-24 Makeup - MIE 1071-MIE_1071 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING
subject: Basic Mechanical Engineering

questions.markdown:
1200 kg of 28.75% wet steam is produced in a coal-fired boiler at a pressure of 1.2 MPa. The feed water to the boiler is supplied from a reservoir maintained at a temperature of 30°C. The steam from the boiler is then sent into a superheater where it is heated to a temperature of 210°C. During this passage from boiler to superheater, the steam condenses and loses 760 MJ of heat. Find the following:

i) Total heat supplied in the boiler.
ii) Dryness fraction of the steam at the entry of superheater
iii) Total heat supplied in the superheater.

A food processing industry operating a water tube boiler, uses 15% wet steam at a temperature of 165°C. The industry has a choice of using wood chips or powdered coal having calorific values of 22 MJ/kg and 30 MJ/kg respectively for firing the boiler. The boiler is to be operated at an average efficiency of 80%. Determine the percentage saving in the quantity of fuel used if coal powder is selected. The steam requirement is 750 kg/day using the feed water at a temperature of 32°C.

Explain the significance of the following mountings:

i) Pressure gauge
ii) Safety valve
iii) Fusible plug

An assembly line uses a belt drive to transfer power from an electric motor to a conveyor belt. The diameter of the motor pulley is 300 mm, and the conveyor belt pulley which is to run in a direction opposite to the motor pulley is designed to have a velocity ratio of 1/3. The centre distance between the two pulleys is 1 m, and the coefficient of friction between the belt and the pulleys is estimated to be 0.25.

Given these parameters:
Infer the type of belt drive used and hence calculate the length of the belt required for this drive system. Also determine the power transmitted by the belt drive if the motor runs at 1440 rpm and the initial tension in the belt drive when stationary is 800 N

An industrial machine uses a combination of a crossed belt drive and a compound gear train for its operation. The initial speed reduction is achieved through a crossed belt drive system, and further reduction is done using a compound gear train with four shafts.

The crossed belt drive consists of a driver pulley with a diameter of 250 mm and a driven pulley with a diameter of 500 mm. The centre distance between the pulleys is 1.5 meters, and the driver pulley rotates at 1200 RPM.

The compound gear train includes four shafts with the following gear specifications:

- Shaft 1: Gear A (Driver) - 20 teeth
- Shaft 2: Gear B - 40 teeth, Gear C - 18 teeth (mounted on the same shaft as Gear B)
- Shaft 3: Gear D - 44 teeth, Gear E - 22 teeth (mounted on the same shaft as Gear D)
- Shaft 4: Gear F (Driven) - 46 teeth

Meshing of gears is as follows: Gear A with Gear B, Gear C with Gear D, and Gear E with Gear F.
Determine the velocity ratio of the compound gear train and the speed of the driven shaft. Sketch the arrangement.

questions.markdown: A factory operates a belt-driven system to transmit power from a motor to various machines. The system should include a pulley arrangement that allows intermittent switching Off and On, of select machines. Analyse the given scenario and identify the type of pulley involved. Explain the working principle of the same with the help of a neat sketch.

The following observations were recorded during a test on a 4-stroke engine. Bore=25cm, Stroke=40cm, Cam Shaft Speed= 125 rpm, Mean effective pressure= 6bar, Fuel consumption= 0.0013kg/sec, Calorific value of the fuel= 43900kJ/kg. Effective brake load = 50 kg, Mean circumference of brake drum = 4 m. Determine the indicated thermal efficiency and brake thermal efficiency.
Sketch and explain the working principle of an engine fitted with a carburetor and is cranked by a lighter flywheel.

Give reasons for the following:

i) Diesel engines have higher compression ratio
ii) Four stroke engines are costlier in comparison to two stroke engines
iii) Piston rings are an essential part of the piston
With suitable sketches, explain tapping, reaming, counter-sinking and counter-boring operations.
Explain the function of saddle, compound rest and feed rod in lathe machine.
Explain any six advantages of CNC machine.
Explain any four desirable characteristics of moulding sand.
With neat sketches, briefly explain the characteristics of various Oxy-Acetylene flame used in gas welding.
Explain the limitations associated with punched tape and tape readers of NC machine.
